About the Leduc service area

Draft copy — pending the owner's review; wording and distances are approximate.

Leduc is south of Edmonton on Highway 2, next door to the international airport, and it has grown fast: newer subdivisions stacked around an older, well-kept core. Both sides of that mix are regular work — colour refreshes in newer builds where the builder-grade beige needs replacing, and careful prep-and-paint in mature homes.

Interior and exterior painting, drywall repair and renovation touch-ups are all on the table in Leduc. The contact form and details are on the main site.

Where we're coming from: the shop is at 10412 66 Ave NW in west Edmonton; Leduc is south of Edmonton on Highway 2, beside the international airport — roughly a twenty-five minute drive from downtown.

Painting & renovation services in Leduc

The same interior, exterior and renovation work the main site describes, phrased for Leduc homes.

Interior Painting

Leduc interior painting: walls, ceilings, trim and woodwork, with tidy prep and clean lines. Furniture and floors are masked and protected; dust is minimised rather than swept under the drop sheet.

Exterior Painting

Leduc exterior work: fascias, soffits, doors, garage siding and masonry accents, prepped and coated to hold up to an Alberta winter. Repairs and rot checks are flagged before the first brush stroke.

Renovation & Touch-Ups

Leduc renovation support: drywall repair and painting, small refreshes, and finishing touch-ups around the rest of the job. Handover-ready rather than almost-finished.
